entries.title: Psalms 80:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Shoshannim-Eduth. Of Asaph. A Psalm.>> Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that sittest [between] the cherubim, shine forth.

entries.title: Psalms 80:2
segments: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy strength, and come to our deliverance.

entries.title: Psalms 80:3
segments: O God, restore us; and cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:4
segments: Jehovah, God of hosts, how long will thine anger smoke against the prayer of thy people?

entries.title: Psalms 80:5
segments: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure:

entries.title: Psalms 80:6
segments: Thou hast made us a strife unto our neighbours, and our enemies mock among themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 80:7
segments: Restore us, O God of hosts; and cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:8
segments: ¶Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt; thou didst cast out the nations, and plant it:

entries.title: Psalms 80:9
segments: Thou preparedst space before it, and it took deep root, and filled the land;

entries.title: Psalms 80:10
segments: The mountains were covered with its shadow, and the branches thereof were [like] cedars of *God;

entries.title: Psalms 80:11
segments: It sent out its boughs unto the sea, and its shoots unto the river.

entries.title: Psalms 80:12
segments: Why hast thou broken down its fences, so that all who pass by the way do pluck it?

entries.title: Psalms 80:13
segments: The boar out of the forest doth waste it, and the beast of the field doth feed off it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:14
segments: O God of hosts, return, we beseech thee; look down from the heavens, and behold, and visit this vine;

entries.title: Psalms 80:15
segments: Even the stock which thy right hand hath planted, and the young plant thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:16
segments: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 80:17
segments: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou hast made strong for thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:18
segments: So will we not go back from thee. Revive us, and we will call upon thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 80:19
segments: Restore us, O Jehovah, God of hosts; cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
